title: Fleet peers: the relayed exchange between group servers (a read request and its answer, both content-addressed and therefore relayable)

Path.description: The read that a group server asks of the cache of a peer group: a GET path of the cache protocol (/<instance>/ac/<sha256>, /<instance>/cas/<sha256> or /<instance>/v1/cache/<key>). Nothing else is ever relayed.

Request.description: Written by the asking server into its own store at v1/fleet/exchange/<to>/requests/<id>.json; the peer reads it through its read-only mount of that store.

Answer.description: Written by the answering server into its own store at v1/fleet/exchange/<from>/answers/<id>.json, after its body <id>.bin; `sha256` and `size` describe the body (absent without a body).
